verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online's own docs reference core financial reporting (13-week P&L and cash-flow forecasting, 'ask for the reports that matter' via Intuit Intelligence, and an MCP server exposing '11 financial reports') supporting on-demand P&L/cash-flow generation, but no evidence explicitly confirms balance sheet reporting, and a community comment notes QBO 'is not feature complete when compared to QuickBooks desktop - hence there are many desktop features and reports which just don't exist in the online product,' raising doubt about full parity. Missing for 10: explicit balance sheet statement evidence, independent verification that all three statements (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) can be generated for any arbitrary period without caveats, and resolution of the desktop-vs-online report-gap complaint.
